require 'socket'
require 'json'
require 'timeout'

module GracefulServer
  BUFFER_POOL_SIZE = 8
  MAX_HEADER_SIZE = 8192
  SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = 30

  class ConnectionBuffer
    attr_accessor :data, :capacity, :write_pos

    def initialize(capacity)
      @capacity = capacity
      @data = "\x00" * capacity
      @write_pos = 0
      @lock = Mutex.new
    end

    def append(chunk)
      @lock.synchronize do
        remaining = @capacity - @write_pos
        copy_len = [chunk.bytesize, remaining].min
        @data[@write_pos, copy_len] = chunk[0, copy_len]
        @write_pos += copy_len
        copy_len
      end
    end

    def reset
      @lock.synchronize do
        @write_pos = 0
      end
    end

    def contents
      @lock.synchronize do
        @data[0, @write_pos]
      end
    end
  end

  class BufferPool
    def initialize(count, buf_size)
      @available = Queue.new
      count.times { @available << ConnectionBuffer.new(buf_size) }
    end

    def acquire
      @available.pop(true) rescue ConnectionBuffer.new(MAX_HEADER_SIZE)
    end

    def release(buf)
      buf.reset
      @available << buf
    end
  end

  class RequestParser
    def initialize(buffer)
      @buffer = buffer
    end

    def parse_headers
      raw = @buffer.contents
      return nil unless raw.include?("\r\n\r\n")

      header_section = raw.split("\r\n\r\n", 2).first
      lines = header_section.split("\r\n")
      request_line = lines.shift

      method, path, version = request_line.split(' ', 3)
      headers = {}
      lines.each do |line|
        key, value = line.split(':', 2)
        headers[key.strip.downcase] = value.strip if key && value
      end

      { method: method, path: path, version: version, headers: headers }
    end
  end

  class HttpServer
    def initialize(host, port)
      @host = host
      @port = port
      @running = false
      @connections = []
      @conn_mutex = Mutex.new
      @pool = BufferPool.new(BUFFER_POOL_SIZE, MAX_HEADER_SIZE)
      @shutdown_phase = :none
      @drain_buffers = {}
    end

    def start
      @running = true
      @server = TCPServer.new(@host, @port)
      setup_signal_handlers

      while @running
        begin
          client = @server.accept_nonblock
          handle_connection(client)
        rescue IO::WaitReadable
          IO.select([@server], nil, nil, 0.5)
        rescue IOError
          break
        end
      end
    ensure
      drain_connections
    end

    private

    def setup_signal_handlers
      Signal.trap('TERM') { initiate_shutdown }
      Signal.trap('INT') { initiate_shutdown }
    end

    def initiate_shutdown
      @shutdown_phase = :draining
      @running = false
      Thread.new { graceful_drain }
    end

    def graceful_drain
      deadline = Time.now + SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
      while Time.now < deadline && active_connections?
        @conn_mutex.synchronize do
          @connections.each do |conn|
            send_drain_response(conn) if conn_alive?(conn)
          end
        end
        sleep 0.1
      end
      @shutdown_phase = :complete
    end

    def send_drain_response(conn)
      buf = @drain_buffers[conn.object_id]
      unless buf
        buf = @pool.acquire
        @drain_buffers[conn.object_id] = buf
      end

      response = build_shutdown_response
      buf.append(response)
      conn.write(buf.contents) rescue nil
    end

    def build_shutdown_response
      body = JSON.generate({ status: 'shutting_down', retry_after: SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT })
      "HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\r\n" \
      "Content-Type: application/json\r\n" \
      "Content-Length: #{body.bytesize}\r\n" \
      "Connection: close\r\n" \
      "\r\n" \
      "#{body}"
    end

    def handle_connection(client)
      @conn_mutex.synchronize { @connections << client }

      Thread.new do
        buffer = @pool.acquire
        begin
          read_request(client, buffer)
          request = RequestParser.new(buffer).parse_headers

          if request && @shutdown_phase == :none
            response = route_request(request)
            client.write(response)
          elsif @shutdown_phase != :none
            client.write(build_shutdown_response)
          end
        rescue => e
          client.write("HTTP/1.1 500\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
        ensure
          client.close rescue nil
          @pool.release(buffer)
          @conn_mutex.synchronize { @connections.delete(client) }
        end
      end
    end

    def read_request(client, buffer)
      loop do
        chunk = client.read_nonblock(4096) rescue nil
        break unless chunk

        written = buffer.append(chunk)
        break if buffer.contents.include?("\r\n\r\n")
        break if buffer.write_pos >= buffer.capacity
      end
    end

    def route_request(request)
      case request[:path]
      when '/health'
        json_response(200, { status: 'ok' })
      when '/chunked'
        handle_chunked_upload(request)
      else
        json_response(404, { error: 'not_found' })
      end
    end

    def handle_chunked_upload(request)
      content_length = (request[:headers]['content-length'] || '0').to_i
      transfer_encoding = request[:headers]['transfer-encoding']

      if transfer_encoding == 'chunked'
        reassembly_size = compute_reassembly_buffer_size(request[:headers])
        reassembly = ConnectionBuffer.new(reassembly_size)
        json_response(200, { received: reassembly.capacity })
      else
        json_response(200, { received: content_length })
      end
    end

    def compute_reassembly_buffer_size(headers)
      declared = (headers['x-expected-size'] || '0').to_i
      trailer_size = (headers['x-trailer-size'] || '0').to_i
      
      # Compute total needed: declared content + trailer metadata
      # Cap at a safe maximum to prevent excessive allocation
      total = declared + trailer_size
      cap = [total, 1048576].min
      cap
    end

    def json_response(status, body)
      json = JSON.generate(body)
      status_text = { 200 => 'OK', 404 => 'Not Found', 503 => 'Service Unavailable' }[status] || 'Unknown'
      "HTTP/1.1 #{status} #{status_text}\r\n" \
      "Content-Type: application/json\r\n" \
      "Content-Length: #{json.bytesize}\r\n" \
      "\r\n" \
      "#{json}"
    end

    def active_connections?
      @conn_mutex.synchronize { @connections.any? }
    end

    def conn_alive?(conn)
      !conn.closed?
    rescue
      false
    end

    def drain_connections
      @conn_mutex.synchronize do
        @connections.each { |c| c.close rescue nil }
        @connections.clear
      end
      @drain_buffers.each_value { |buf| @pool.release(buf) }
      @drain_buffers.clear
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  server = GracefulServer::HttpServer.new('0.0.0.0', 8080)
  server.start
end
